i.content:
# pH probe calibration
1. Rinse the probe with deionised water.
2. Calibrate in pH 7 buffer first, then pH 4. Wait about 30 seconds for the reading to stabilise each time.
3. Add pH 10 buffer only when samples will be above pH 8.
4. Check the slope. Below 95%, replace the probe.
5. Store in KCl storage solution, never in water.

steps.a: All six notes are kept and ordered as a procedure. I read the note about KCl as storage solution; if it means something else, that step is wrong.

reference.summary: Turned rough lab notes into a numbered runbook for calibrating a pH probe, keeping every step and putting them in the order they would be done. One interpretation, that KCl means the storage solution, was flagged for confirmation.
facts: buffers pH 7 then 4, 10 only for samples above 8
replace the probe if slope is under 95%
